title: Bengal Nights
subtitle: Forbidden Passions in Colonial Calcutta
summary: Bengal Nights sweeps readers into the sultry, mysterious world of 1930s Calcutta, where cultures collide and boundaries blur. When a young European intellectual finds himself entranced by the enigmatic Maitreyi, their initial encounter is fraught with bewilderment and fascination—an attraction made perilous by the rigid customs and prejudices of colonial India. Through a haze of sensual detail and introspective longing, the novel explores the intoxicating thrill and inevitable anguish of forbidden love. Mircea Eliade’s evocative prose immerses you in the charged atmosphere of a city alive with tradition and change, where every stolen glance promises both ecstasy and heartbreak.
